heading: Seeds and reports from Department of Agriculture
lead: Seeds and agricultural reports emanating from the Department of Agriculture may be mailed—

tree.text: as penalty mail by the Secretary of Agriculture; and
during the 90-day period immediately following the expiration of their terms of office, as franked mail by Members of Congress.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1981—Par. (2). Pub. L. 97–69 substituted “during the 90-day period immediately” for “until the thirtieth day of June”.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective July 1, 1971, pursuant to Resolution No. 71–9 of the Board of Governors. See section 15(a) of Pub. L. 91–375, set out as a note preceding section 101 of this title.
